requirement.normalizedRequirement: To prevent local web buckling, h_w/t_wn <= 282/sqrt(sigma_y) for flat-bar sections and h_w/t_wn <= 805/sqrt(sigma_y) for bulb, tee and angle sections.
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: To prevent local buckling in the web, h_w/t_wn <= 282/sqrt(sigma_y) for flat-bar sections and h_w/t_wn <= 805/sqrt(sigma_y) for bulb, tee and angle sections.
